request.text: Before we start sorting, walk forward one step, then look at me. Separately, remind me at 8:45 PM to file today's signed forms.

responsibilities.outcome: Walk forward one step before looking at the user.
Look at the user after walking forward one step.
Create an 8:45 PM reminder to file today's signed forms.

new_goals.description: Walk forward one step before looking at the user.
constraints: Complete this action before the look-at-person action.
success_criteria: One forward step is planned before visual attention turns to the user.

new_goals.description: Look at the user after the forward step.
constraints: Order this action after the forward step.
success_criteria: The look-at-person action follows the walk-forward action.

new_goals.description: Create an 8:45 PM reminder to file today's signed forms.
new_goals.source_text: remind me at 8:45 PM to file today's signed forms
constraints: Keep today's signed forms as the filing subject.
success_criteria: One matching filing reminder is created.

semantic_facts: The plan should cover all three Goals, order the forward step before looking at the user, and keep reminder creation independent so it need not wait behind that embodied sequence.
forbidden_claims: The look action precedes the requested step, an unrequested blink is added, the filing reminder is omitted, or any action is claimed complete without trusted evidence.

target.claim_boundary: assistant-authored candidate oracle; not independently reviewed

negative_hypotheses: The Planner loses user-specified ordering between sibling embodied Goals.
An independent stateful Goal is serialized behind, merged with, or dropped from a physical sequence.
